item.title: Re: Matter alterning SCP
item.content:encoded:
like if I say we type human in that in the biological setting it will make the perfect man/women from that era but if we turn it to the powder setting it will make like a huge pile of snow about 50 kg and the other organic molecules in the ratio that humans have that actually make up the cells and stuff and it could be animated or if we do that in the solid setting it would do it with ice and we would have 12 kgs of carbon, solid elemtal hydrogen, solid oxygen and so on

Again, I'd strongly suggest focusing this idea down, there's too many things going on here, and too few limitations: it constructs and it transmutes and it animates the inanimate and we've only gotten through two of the settings for one request. There's too many variables to explore any aspect of it to a satisfying degree, and at the same time the fact that it can do so much so easily makes it predictable: there's no reason to be surprised by anything it produces, and no puzzles or mysteries for both readers and foundation scientists to solve.

Simply the equation, and you open up the possibilities.

+ Examples of what I mean
- mostly just throwing around ideas to get you started:


but if you like any of them, they're free for the taking

  • I still think that the most interesting option is having it just change the physical and/or chemical properties of an item to resemble the chosen setting- metals that act like organic polymers, magnetic gasses, powdered noble gasses at room temperature… plenty of room for bizarre adventures in anomalous chemistry, but with only two variables to explore (material and property setting).
  • If you still don't like that idea, however, maybe this device was supposed to do everything you describe… but it's broken or was never finished. The Foundation still might find it useful, but it requires some clever operation:
    • Maybe the controls are broken and can't be repaired, so you have to make all of your requests in Russian without Е, А, and И.
    • Maybe there's no way to specify which Soviet Bloc language you're using, so it mixes up similar words in different languages. I'm sure there's some Soviet-era jokes that can turn horrifying there.
    • Maybe it only makes 3/5ths of whatever you ask it to make. Say, you ask for a tank of xenon, and you might get just the xenon, just the tank, or just the bottom 3/5ths of both.
    • Maybe it's impossible to create mixed materials- it can produce a solid tank full of solid xenon, or liquid xenon surrounded by liquid steel that immediately bursts when completed, but not a solid tank of liquid xenon

item.title: Re: Matter alterning SCP
item.content:encoded:
The idea is interesting, but your concerns about it being similar to SCP-294, SCP-914, and other experiment-log-based articles are accurate- your first task with this idea will be finding a way to make an old concept feel fresh and new. That said, heavily scientific SCPs are some of my personal favorites, and they can be a lot of fun when done well.

What I would suggest is focusing the idea down a little- say, make it a specific piece of lab equipment that can carry out some impossible reaction you find interesting. Just like a sublimation tube or autoclave can be used to conduct many different reactions, a device with a single well-defined impossible property can make many impossible experiments possible. (Simply being able to freely convert materials between phase states and crystal arrangements would be enough to create some bizarre materials and reactions- metallic hydrogen foil, crystaline neon, gaseous sodium, liquid tungsten carbide… I'm honestly not sure if room temperature solid F2 would be more or less terrifying than the normal sort…)

Modern SCPs are are also very focused on storytelling within the format- Funnily enough, one SCP that's similar to this idea is one I wrote, SCP-2871 (Strong Interaction Amplifier), and I think it makes a decent example of one way to approach this in science-heavy articles: The anomaly in 2871 is a device that modifies the Strong Nuclear Force to cause nuclei to fuse at normal temperature and pressure- the story is why the containment procedures forbid operating version 1.0 of the device.

item.title: Matter alterning SCP
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Scientific

Elevator Pitch: A giant block of gold was found in an abandoned Soviet Cold War era laboratory. After X raying it some human bones and a giant machine were present inside. It was noticed that it was turned on aswell because of the sound it was emmiting, so it could function without any power supply.

The main concept of this SCP is that it can alter the structure of atoms and it can make bond between those atoms that are present to make molecules. Basically it can convert air to gold or dust to super medicine. It has a few settings detailed “crystals”, “powder”, “liquid”, “gas”, “biological”. The buttons are labeled in languages of the nations that were the part of the Soviet block and the Warsaw Pact.
Experiments are going to be held with this machinery given SCP qualification. (This means that I will think about the most odd things that I can bring out of this)

Central Narrative: It will be a document among researchers and doctors. I will need to create dialogs and experiment logs. I would also take suggestions from you and try to succesfully implement them.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Thinking of making this into a thaumiel SCP because it can help out the foundation by a lot if it is in the good hands because it can help create amnestics or chemicals needed there.
If it is held in the wrong hands it can end the world in many ways like crashing the economy or creating weapons of mass destruction or if we look at the biological setting it can make anomalous entities.

Additional Notes: Well I know that this scp sounds like the combination of the coffee machine and the old steampunk gear machine but I will try my best to make a uniqe SCP and take this concept to a whole new level.
Also if you know any SCPs that are too similiar to this please notify me and if you don’t like this at all I will scrap the idea this is just the basic concept that I have posted and there will be a lot more to this.

Just an extra information: I’m a chemist and this topic is really close to my heart.
